sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Maledisant was an Arthurian heroine. Her name means ill speech. She derided a knight named Bruno until she fell in love with him. Her speech then became sugary and sweet. She is an obscure character in Arthurian legend.

okr.objective: Document Maledisant, the Arthurian heroine whose name means ill speech.
key_results: Record the meaning of the name Maledisant.
Record her derision of Bruno and her later love for him.
